doc: stages/filters.csf.rst: 'The **Cloth Simulation Filter (CSF)** classifies ground points based on the approach outlined in [Zhang2016]_.' terrain.las is a 40x40 ground plane (1600 points) plus two raised blocks (52 points), all Classification 0 on input. The sample pipeline extracts ground with Classification[2:2], so ground is 2: exactly the 1600 plane points.
